review.uncertainty: This chunk removes a compatibility flag and its associated conditional branching. The removed flag, keyset_full_load_enabled, was used to preserve a server-cursor path for activity payloads recorded before a rollout completed. Its removal and the accompanying removal of the conditional check that honored False values indicates the compatibility period has ended. This is a cleanup,
